# v0.1.17 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.17. The capability version is 12.

`diagnose --since` explains skipped and refused runs from a state
directory. A poll submission now reaches a final commit status, and
`submissions` lists, inspects, abandons, retries, and repairs the ones
that do not. Worker storage counts each inode once and reports its
pressure, `storage-plan --dry-run` lists what a prune would remove,
jobs that wait for capacity stay on a backlog, and the worker reports
`worker_unavailable` from a heartbeat file. `check` compares a job with
the capability floor of the deployed engine.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
